title: Savings plan
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y9 lesson 6 (Savings plan (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Saving, riba and halal ways to save. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Why save?
points: Big goals: hajj, a car, a home

blocks.h: Halal ways to save and grow

frame.label: Monthly amount and how many months
A halal place to keep it, and why
Zakah: if my savings reach the nisab and are kept for a lunar year, 2.5% is due

keywords.def: money paid for lending or borrowing money
sharing real business profit and risk, as in mudarabah

questions.q: Zakah on £8,000 savings held a lunar year above nisab?
Core: Savings plan (pupil PDF): a goal, a monthly amount, and a halal place to keep it; include zakah if due.
Extend: In the portal response box, explain why Islam forbids riba. Start: 'Riba is forbidden because...'
questions.a: Riba is forbidden because Allah forbade it (2:275); it guarantees gain without shared risk and can trap the poor in debt.

questions.q: Stretch: Compare a profit-sharing account with an interest account: who carries the risk?
questions.a: Interest: the borrower; profit-sharing: shared between the bank and saver.

questions.q: Which is a halal way to grow savings?
options: A profit-sharing account based on real trade
questions.a: B) A profit-sharing account based on real trade. Profit-sharing in real trade avoids riba; the others involve interest.

questions.q: Riba is... A) charity B) interest, forbidden in Islam C) zakah
Big question: is 4% interest a gift? What could a Muslim do instead?
questions.a: No, it is riba; use halal profit-sharing or keep savings safely.
